messages:
mia-cs: Quick weekly health check for BrightBank — can we do a short status on the recent model shift to rw-chat-v2-lite? I flagged higher fallbacks and spend increase in dashboards.
raj-se: Looking. Canary started last Tue at 25% then we bumped to 60% Wed for peak traffic. Sharing quick numbers below.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic adjusted to 60% at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z by raj-se.
raj-se: Metrics (last 7d): adoption ~42% of requests to rw-chat-v2-lite, overall fallback rate 6% baseline -> peaked at 10% Wed 15:18 UTC during batch window. p50/p95 latency for v2-lite 210ms / 420ms vs rw-chat-v1 180ms / 320ms. Error rate baseline 0.6% -> brief spike to 2.1% during peak.
olivia-csm: Customer noticed slowdowns during their EOD imports and said they saw more `timeout` errors. They're asking if we can pause the rollout if this persists.
support-bot: Alert: increased 5xx rate for BrightBank route brightbank/ingest from 2026-03-17T15:12 to 2026-03-17T15:26; aggregated 502s = 18 (rate +1.4% over baseline).
raj-se: Root cause hypothesis: larger average context + our kernel choice for v2-lite at >1k tokens leads to heavier execution path, causing p95 regressions and occasional OOM fallbacks to v1. Also batch behavior during their import bursts reduces effective batch efficiency.
sam-product: Noting that v2-lite uses new attention kernel that we tuned for short chats — batchy long requests reveal perf cliff. We expected some regressions; we should tighten rollout policy.
mia-cs: For customer-facing next steps: they want either a pause or mitigation this week. Recommend options?
raj-se: Quick mitigations we can do now: 1) set BrightBank to fixed routing to rw-chat-v1 for their ingest route during 02:00-04:00 local (their batch window). 2) Enable prefix-KV caching for repeated system prompts. 3) Reduce canary to 30% and monitor.
olivia-csm: I'll propose option 1 to the customer (route ingest -> v1 during batch) and offer a rollback if problems persist.
mia-cs: Please include the expected impact numbers when you offer: estimated fallback down to ~2-3% and p95 return to ~330ms for ingest path.
raj-se: Action items: - raj-se: implement routing override for brightbank/ingest -> due 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC; - sam-product: evaluate kernel tuning/quantization profile for v2-lite long contexts -> due 2026-03-20; - olivia-csm: update customer with mitigation + rollback option -> today EOD. I'll add a brief playbook note in the account.
support-bot: Ticket created CS-4821: "BrightBank ingest regressions during v2-lite rollout" assigned to raj-se, olivia-csm.
mia-cs: Also flag renewal risk? If we can contain within 48h and show improved metrics, low risk. If not, escalate to AM.
sam-product: I'll simulate their batch pattern with 3k token sessions and push a repro to the perf queue.
raj-se: I'll monitor fallbacks and latency dashboards; setting alert thresholds: fallback rate >5% OR p95 >380ms -> ping #customer-success-alerts and open incident.
olivia-csm: Noted. I'll coordinate a quick enablement doc for them on token limits + chunking suggestions.
mia-cs: Thanks all — please post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
